title: MCPTracer bench --json output (v2)
description: Output of `mcptracer bench <session-id> --json -- <server-command>`. v2 adds `schema_version`, a required integer field naming the major version of this schema the document conforms to, so a CI job pinned to a schema can detect the shape it received instead of guessing from content; v1 had no version marker. Bump the filename version and add a new schema on any breaking change; do not edit this file in place once published.

latency_max_ms.description: null in every one of these latency fields only when total_requests is 0 (no request ever received a response to time).
